events.title: Private Playtest Is Coming!
events.summary: Hi Everyone! Join Q-Games' Discord right now to be first in line for the free Private Playtest of PixelJunk Monsters 3, beginning Sept 4th! We are excited to announce that we are opening the doors to a 120-hour public playtest on PC for our Discord users, running from September 4 to September 9, 2026, in celebration of Q-Games' 25th anniversary. Join the Discord now for more updates and news. Start:JST: September 4, 2026, 10:00 AMCEST: September 4, 2026, 3:00 AMPDT: September 3, 2026, 6:00 PMEnd

events.title: Announcing PixelJunk Monsters 3 at Future Game Show at Gamescom!
events.summary: We at Q-Games are excited to announce PixelJunk Monsters 3, the latest entry in our popular PixelJunk series, and reveal its new trailer at Future Game Show at Gamescom 2026! Future Game Show at Gamescom2026 Announce TrailerPixelJunk Monsters 3 returns to its original hand-drawn roots and is now presented in 4K for extra fidelity.
